requirement:
修复订单数据模型的 bug。
订单实体类的字段定义有误，导致序列化时数据丢失。
需要修正订单模型并检查所有引用订单数据的服务。

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: Handles other order types and likely shares or references the order data model, so it may need updates.

details.name: ts-admin-order-service
details.rationale: Admin service for orders, likely consumes order data and may need to align with corrected model.

details.name: ts-preserve-other-service
details.rationale: Similar to preserve-service, handles other order creation and may reference order model.

details.name: ts-cancel-service
details.rationale: Cancels orders and likely reads/writes order data, so it may need to adapt to corrected model.

details.name: ts-preserve-service
details.rationale: Preserve service creates orders and may serialize order data, so it could be affected by model changes.

details.name: ts-rebook-service
details.rationale: Rebooking involves order data and may serialize or deserialize order entities.

details.name: ts-inside-payment-service
details.rationale: Internal payment service likely references order data for transactions.

details.name: ts-payment-service
details.rationale: Payment processing uses order information, so it may need to align with corrected model.

details.name: ts-wait-order-service
details.rationale: Manages wait orders and may interact with order data structures.

details.name: ts-execute-service
details.rationale: Executes order-related operations and may reference order model fields.

details.name: ts-notification-service
details.rationale: Sends notifications about orders and may parse order data, so it could be affected.

details.name: ts-gateway-service
details.rationale: Gateway routes requests to order services but may not directly manipulate order model; lower confidence.

details.name: ts-travel-service
details.rationale: Travel service may indirectly use order data but less likely to need changes; low confidence.

details.name: ts-travel2-service
details.rationale: Similar to travel-service, may have indirect dependencies on order data.
